name: Nanaka
message: 「O-Of course it will! There's no way you've got the guts to jump me, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Me!? W-What are you suddenly talking about!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, I mean, l-look, I'm a girl, and you're a guy, right」

name: Synn
message: 「……Do you really think I'm the kind of person who'd do that?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, I literally just said there's no way you would!」

name: Synn
message: 「That still means you think I'd jump you if I only had the guts!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Soba actually wants him to jump her」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Paqy. Saying stuff like that in the middle of patrol really isn't cool」

name: Synn
message: 「You too, Nanaka. Don't make weird jokes at a time like this, okay」

name: Nanaka
message: 「O-Oh, yeah…… Y-You're right. Guess I was just a little nervous」

name: Synn
message: 「If we're just up against ordinary demons, the two of us should be able to handle them somehow」

name: Synn
message: 「If those strong demons show up and things get dicey, I'll draw them away, so you call everyone on your phone, Nanaka」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll be fine. I can at least buy enough time for everyone to rush over」

name: Paqy
message: 「Having Master Synn act as the decoy is the logical call」

name: Paqy
message: 「Neither Master Synn nor the great me has a cell phone」

name: Synn
message: 「Having a cell phone must be amazing. Apparently the newest ones can even send photos and play games」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, they've been able to do that for a pretty long time」

name: Paqy
message: 「Awesome. How does it send photos when it's just a phone? Is it magic?」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe it has a fax machine attached?」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, it's thoughtography! They must have scientifically figured out the principles of thoughtography!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We finally get a moment alone together in the dark... so why are we having such an idiotic conversation...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You know how digital cameras and computers turn images into data? It's the same thing」
A presence, as if the darkness had grown thicker.

name: Paqy
message: 「No... this one... smells like a Demon」

name: Sally
message: 「I was already pissed off from getting lectured and kept late at my part-time job, and I still went out of my way to rush over here 'cause I sensed a suspicious presence!」

name: Sally
message: 「I got hungry during my shift, and right there in front of me was a beef bowl... eheh, I just couldn't help myself」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't give me 'couldn't help myself'! No wonder you got yelled at!!」

name: Synn
message: 「A suspicious presence... Then what I felt earlier was...」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah. There were a whole bunch of presences I didn't recognize either」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaaat!? Then I've gotta send an emergency email to everyone!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, wait a sec, Synn, there's something... different about 'em than usual!!」

name: Synn
message: 「They might look a little cute, but... we can't let our guard down」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, I'm totally ticked off right now!」
